zones.name: YELLOW ZONE
zones.terrain: The assembly yards still hum beneath the dead power grid.

ctfs.title: Challenge Pending · Y-01
ctfs.briefing: A corrupted signal was detected beneath the industrial quarantine. Recover the surviving record.

ctfs.title: Challenge Pending · Y-02
ctfs.briefing: A fragmented archive is sealed behind a failing terminal. Determine which fragments can still be trusted.

ctfs.title: Challenge Pending · Y-03
ctfs.briefing: The first quarantine log ends mid-transmission. Reconstruct the missing evidence.

zones.name: BLUE ZONE
zones.terrain: Cold water has swallowed the server farms. Something still answers the ping.

ctfs.title: Challenge Pending · B-01
ctfs.briefing: A submerged data vault is sending a signal through the static. Trace its origin.

ctfs.title: Challenge Pending · B-02
ctfs.briefing: The backup cluster disagrees with its own logs. Find the intact chain of evidence.

ctfs.title: Challenge Pending · B-03
ctfs.briefing: A cold-storage manifest survived the flood, but its records are out of order.

zones.name: ORANGE ZONE
zones.terrain: The refinery burns on an endless loop. Data is melting in the heat.

ctfs.title: Challenge Pending · O-01
ctfs.briefing: A refinery sensor has recorded impossible readings. Separate the signal from the noise.

ctfs.title: Challenge Pending · O-02
ctfs.briefing: The incident report has been scorched. Restore the sequence of events from the remnants.

ctfs.title: Challenge Pending · O-03
ctfs.briefing: A machine keeps rewriting its own output. Identify the last trustworthy state.

zones.name: RED ZONE
zones.terrain: The infection is thick enough to distort memory. Do not trust the first answer.

ctfs.title: Challenge Pending · R-01
ctfs.briefing: A forbidden archive is protected by layers of deliberate misinformation.

ctfs.title: Challenge Pending · R-02
ctfs.briefing: A terminal claims the incident never happened. Its process memory says otherwise.

ctfs.title: Challenge Pending · R-03
ctfs.briefing: The final infection report has been split across unreliable sources. Correlate the remnants.

zones.name: PURPLE ZONE
zones.terrain: Reality fractures at the centre of the collapse. This is where the data died.

ctfs.title: Challenge Pending · P-01
ctfs.briefing: The core's first memory is fragmented between competing realities. Reconcile the truth.

ctfs.title: Challenge Pending · P-02
ctfs.briefing: PRALAYA is replaying a corrupted world-state. Find the anomaly that breaks the loop.

ctfs.title: Challenge Pending · P-03
ctfs.briefing: One final dataset remains. Recover it, and decide what survives the end.
